10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

1495|54c6960c.name: Deathguard Linnea
1495|54c6960c.text: Greetings, $C. Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark. Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.

1496|54d7bdcd.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|54d7bdcd.text: Take it, then. It seems Zygand is too busy for the agonizing trip here to retrieve it himself.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

2238|5408b909.name: Tog'thar
2238|5408b909.text: Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.

246152|942bf955.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|942bf955.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

248197|cc5aee35.name: Gor'mak
248197|cc5aee35.text: You won't find better equipment anywhere else!

248201|b9df183f.name: Pawani
248201|b9df183f.text: Greetings, friend! I have ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

248202|055d4e51.name: Jim'bek
248202|055d4e51.text:
<Jim'bek locks eyes with you as he takes a deep puff from his hookah.>

'Ello, mon. Need a rug? A blanket? Or just some cloth for your next project? I got you.

251001|379c835f.name: Deathguard Kristof
251001|379c835f.text:
Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.

252068|528b5824.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|528b5824.text: Have you heard the good news about Al'Akir, the Windlord?

252068|7bf8836d.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|7bf8836d.text: Why are you asking me, unshaven novice?

253474|404ff1f4.name: Peacekeeper
253474|404ff1f4.text: That trainer can be found in the Crafter's Hall, on the west side of Valanaar.

254149|50d3b408.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|50d3b408.text:
Shadowgale Forest!

It's haunted! Haunted as the sky is blue! Terrible forest spirits, terror birds with talons as big as yer arm! It's... a nightmare!

<Swimmers turns to Donaal and belches loudly.>

 IT'S NOT CRAZY TALK, DONAAL!

254149|f642f017.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|f642f017.text:
<The $r before you sways unsteadily, clearly very inebriated.>

I used to be a sailor you know? Before the trouble started. The skycutters used to run between the islands. Now its unsafe or some such, or so they say.

I see the High Order and the Windshapers have their skycutters running again, but I'm stuck here, grounded! 

What aren't we being told!

<He turns and yells loudly at the innkeeper.>

WHAT AREN'T WE BEING TOLD, DONAAL!?

254345|bedfc7be.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|bedfc7be.text: Nostyec Regenthor, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

256514|4f344806.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|4f344806.text: Anyway, I should probably get back to work. Speaking of, do you have any food or valuables that I could lift off of you? Maybe some windstones? Could always use more windstones?

256514|5198072d.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|5198072d.text: Look around you. There's so much beauty here. The wind on your face, the blue skies overhead. It's so bright and alive, but yes, it's also quite dark. It feels like a prison. A prison where the guards have all left the prisoners in their cells to fend for themselves.

256514|6387fa8c.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|6387fa8c.text: Just thinking. It's scary out here these days, you know? Any minute this section of the island could drop out from under me and I'd go tumbling... somewhere? Tell me, do you even know what happens to $r who fall off the island?

256514|64ae14a6.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|64ae14a6.text: <A solitary bandit sits on the edge of the precipice, clearly deep in thought. If he notices you, he doesn't seem interested in attacking you.>

256514|8851d200.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|8851d200.text: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.

256514|bde78361.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|bde78361.text:
No one does. Because the only people who've done it have never come back. When the skycutters used to run between Valanaar and New Eldranaar or Shen'dramar, sometimes an accident or other misfortune would cause someone to go overboard. When it happened, they wouldn't even slow the ship down. No point.

For all we know, anyone who fell off is still out there... tumbling endlessly forever.

257003|fb513610.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

257005|45c78ce3.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|45c78ce3.text: Nostyec Aetwinter, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

257008|c65683ed.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257019|45c78ce3.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|45c78ce3.text: Nostyec Aetwinter, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

265756|0cf2d0bd.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|0cf2d0bd.text:
Welcome to Fairweather Stables! I would love to provide you one of our fine galestriders, but it seems like you may not yet have enough experience to ride one.

They are temperamental at times and are prone to toss newer riders if not handled correctly. I would be more than happy to provide the training for you once you are a more seasoned adventurer and have enough coin!

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

4565|db7f8bbb.name: Richard Kerwin
4565|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

4596|b22b0c37.name: James Van Brunt
4596|b22b0c37.text: How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

1471-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
1471-progress.text: I expect to hear of your success, $N. Not meeting my expectations will be the least of your worries, however, should you fail.
1471-progress.title: The Binding

1473-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
1473-progress.text:
Egalin was the teacher that taught me. With hardly a look, he was able to command the voidwalker he had summoned.

When it came my turn to try, I was overconfident. Do not trifle with the powers that you wield, $N, they can consume even the vigilant.
1473-progress.title: Creature of the Void

1639-complete.name: Bartleby
1639-complete.text: Hello, fancy boy!  What's a prissy thing like you doing in the Pig and Whistle?  Be careful, or you might break a nail...
1639-complete.title: Bartleby the Drunk

1665-progress.name: Harry Burlguard
1665-progress.text: I saw your fight with Bartleby.  Nicely done!  Did you get his mug?
1665-progress.title: Bartleby's Mug

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the $r lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

430-complete.name: Quinn Yorick
430-complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

<A few moments pass in suspenseful silence.>
430-complete.title: Return to Quinn

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

527-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-progress.text:
As High Executor of Tarren Mill, under the direct command of Varimathras and the Dark Lady, you are subject to follow my command.

Perhaps you take this war with the Alliance lightly?  If such is the case I should behead you right here and now.  Otherwise, travel west to the town of Hillsbrad and wage battle against the humans, as ordered.

Dismissed.
527-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6322-progress.name: Michael Garrett
6322-progress.text: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
6322-progress.title: Michael Garrett

6323-progress.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-progress.text: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
6323-progress.title: Ride to the Undercity

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

78127-complete.name: Owen Thadd
78127-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78127-complete.title: The Dalaran Digest

78127-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78127-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78127-progress.title: The Dalaran Digest

79095-complete.name: Owen Thadd
79095-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79095-complete.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

91858-accept.name: Danitha Morr
91858-accept.text:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858-accept.title: Diplomatic Incident

91858-complete.name: Trevan Rol
91858-complete.text: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, $c.
91858-complete.title: Diplomatic Incident

91859-accept.name: Trevan Rol
91859-accept.text:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859-accept.title: A Curious Pair

91859-complete.name: Deathguard Baldren
91859-complete.text: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?
91859-complete.title: A Curious Pair

91860-accept.name: Deathguard Baldren
91860-accept.text:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860-accept.title: A Grim Fate

91860-complete.name: Deathguard Baldren
91860-complete.text:
<The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?

This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>
91860-complete.title: A Grim Fate

91861-accept.name: Unknown
91861-accept.text: <The fact that you only found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
91861-accept.title: Into Fenris Keep

91861-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
91861-complete.text:
You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me? 

Time is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!
91861-complete.title: Into Fenris Keep

91862-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-accept.text:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862-accept.title: Lumina Windsinger

91862-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-complete.text: Thank you, $c. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.
91862-complete.title: Lumina Windsinger

91862-progress.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-progress.text: Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.
91862-progress.title: Lumina Windsinger

91904-progress.name: Dokimi
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91920-accept.name: Quinn Yorick
91920-accept.text:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920-accept.title: Wild Eyes

91920-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
91920-complete.text:
The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.

However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...

<Renferrel takes the eyes.>

I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.
91920-complete.title: Wild Eyes

91921-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
91921-accept.text:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
91921-accept.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

91921-complete.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, $N.
91921-complete.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

92516-complete.name: Teeri Wellwind
92516-complete.text: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.
92516-complete.title: Hippogryph Harrassment

92528-accept.name: Missionary Jasaan
92528-accept.text:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528-accept.title: Among the Faithful

92528-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92528-complete.text:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.
92528-complete.title: Among the Faithful

92529-complete.name: Missionary Jasaan
92529-complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.
92529-complete.title: Falaath Village

92550-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92550-accept.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550-accept.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92550-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92550-complete.text:
Thank the winds you've returned!

Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.

You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

Winds guide you, $N.
92550-complete.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92550-progress.name: Constable Aonda
92550-progress.text: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.
92550-progress.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92551-accept.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-accept.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551-accept.title: Stolen Supplies

92551-complete.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-complete.text: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.
92551-complete.title: Stolen Supplies

92551-progress.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-progress.text: There's a lot of hungry and desperate $r here who need these supplies.
92551-progress.title: Stolen Supplies

92579-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92579-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92579-accept.title: To Valanaar

92579-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92579-complete.text:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.
92579-complete.title: To Valanaar

92579-progress.name: Valennia Stormfist
92579-progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92579-progress.title: To Valanaar

92679-accept.name: Alvarion Windfield
92679-accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The $R man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679-accept.title: Blood Tithe

92679-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92679-complete.text:
<Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>

At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.

Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.
92679-complete.title: Blood Tithe

92682-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-accept.text:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682-accept.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-complete.text: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.
92682-complete.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-progress.text: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
92682-progress.title: Make Yourself Useful

92683-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-accept.text:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
92683-accept.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-complete.text:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.
92683-complete.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-progress.text: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
92683-progress.title: Flutterfly Dust

92684-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-accept.text:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684-accept.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-complete.text: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
92684-complete.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-progress.text: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
92684-progress.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-accept.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685-accept.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-complete.text:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?
92685-complete.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
92685-progress.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
92693-accept.title: Standing Our Ground

92693-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-complete.text: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.
92693-complete.title: Standing Our Ground

92693-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-progress.text: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
92693-progress.title: Standing Our Ground

92698-accept.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
92698-accept.text:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
92698-accept.title: What Is My Purpose?

92698-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92698-complete.text:
The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.
92698-complete.title: What Is My Purpose?

92700-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92700-accept.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92700-accept.title: The Grand Skyseer

92700-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92700-complete.text:
Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.

You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.

I look forward to further making your acquaintance.
92700-complete.title: The Grand Skyseer

92703-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92703-accept.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $N. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703-accept.title: Deliver the News

92703-complete.name: Alvarion Windfield
92703-complete.text:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.
92703-complete.title: Deliver the News

92708-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92708-accept.text:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurer's like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
92708-accept.title: A Grand Adventure

92708-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92708-complete.text:
So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.

Will you have the courage to join us when the time comes?
92708-complete.title: A Grand Adventure

93159-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93159-accept.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
93159-accept.title: The Strange Hermit

93159-complete.name: Strange Hermit
93159-complete.text:
...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.
93159-complete.title: The Strange Hermit

93160-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93160-accept.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160-accept.title: The Forest's Bounty

93172-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93172-accept.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but its definitely a song and its... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172-accept.title: Free the Hollows

93317-accept.name: Nyalah Brightfire
93317-accept.text:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317-accept.title: Crab Season

93318-complete.name: Danarii Bellowveil
93318-complete.text: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.
93318-complete.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93318-progress.name: Danarii Bellowveil
93318-progress.text: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.
93318-progress.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93735-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93735-accept.text:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735-accept.title: The Broken Construct

93735-complete.name: Riaani Nightwind
93735-complete.text:
<Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.>

Storms curse where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!
93735-complete.title: The Broken Construct

93736-accept.name: Endaria Mistgaze
93736-accept.text:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736-accept.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93737-accept.name: Riaani Nightwind
93737-accept.text:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
93737-accept.title: The Broken Construct

93926-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93926-accept.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge, let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!
93926-accept.title: The Western Watch

93926-complete.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93926-complete.text: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, its clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>
93926-complete.title: The Western Watch

93927-accept.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93927-accept.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927-accept.title: A Last Request

93927-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93927-complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse on these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
93927-complete.title: A Last Request

93927-progress.name: Constable Aonda
93927-progress.text: What news from the western watch?
93927-progress.title: A Last Request

93948-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93948-accept.text:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948-accept.title: Deliver the Signet

93948-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93948-complete.text:
I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.

It's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.
93948-complete.title: Deliver the Signet

93948-progress.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93948-progress.text: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.
93948-progress.title: Deliver the Signet

93949-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93949-accept.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
93949-accept.title: Bugged

93951-complete.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-complete.text:
It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible. 

If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.
93951-complete.title: A Little Beauty

93951-progress.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-progress.text: What beautiful things did you bring me?
93951-progress.title: A Little Beauty

94013-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-accept.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts, it's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the $c.
94013-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94013-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-complete.text:
Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $c that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
94013-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94013-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94013-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94050-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94050-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.
94050-accept.title: Training the Beast

94050-complete.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
94050-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94050-complete.title: Training the Beast

94484-accept.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94484-accept.text:
A moment, if you will $N. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able go, seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484-accept.title: Unnerving Silence

94484-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94484-complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484-complete.title: Unnerving Silence

94485-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485-accept.title: Tears of the Lady

94486-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486-accept.title: Feathers for Binding

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94896-accept.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-accept.text:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896-accept.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897-accept.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-accept.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897-accept.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94978-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-accept.text:
Every $c begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94978-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-complete.text: Well tamed, $N! You are becoming adept already.
94978-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94978-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94978-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94979-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-accept.text:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler, now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the Galestrider, a proud, winged $c that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94979-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94979-progress.title: Taming the Beast

95034-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95034-accept.text:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034-accept.title: The Debt

95034-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
95034-complete.text:
So now you understand. At the very end of his strength after being pierced by a dozen gnoll blades, he reared up to strike me. In that final moment we locked eyes, and I could tell he still knew who he was and that he recognized me. He knew what was happening but he had no control over himself. That was the worst part.

If such a thing is possible, I will see the creature that doomed him dead so that it can never visit this horror on another living thing. I swear it upon the sky above.
95034-complete.title: The Debt

95036-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95036-accept.text:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036-accept.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95036-complete.name: Trevan Rol
95036-complete.text: Now that we've got the materials we need, we just need a smith to craft the blade for us. I think I know just such a smith.
95036-complete.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95036-progress.name: Trevan Rol
95036-progress.text: Trust in the light to guide your blade. However, the light needs a good blade to guide.
95036-progress.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95042-accept.name: Ulric Frostveil
95042-accept.text:
A Forsaken $c... here in Ashenvale? Amusing. 

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the Alliance. Why should a fallen $c like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, $c.
95042-accept.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

95042-complete.name: Ulric Frostveil
95042-complete.text:
You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, the magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.

I don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you to seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... academic pursuits.
95042-complete.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

95042-progress.name: Ulric Frostveil
95042-progress.text: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.
95042-progress.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

95111-accept.name: Trevan Rol
95111-accept.text:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111-accept.title: An Underrated Talent

95111-complete.name: Ott
95111-complete.text:
Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but it's honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory.

I'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.
95111-complete.title: An Underrated Talent

95111-progress.name: Ott
95111-progress.text: Are you in need of a blade, $c?
95111-progress.title: An Underrated Talent

95125-accept.name: Ott
95125-accept.text:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125-accept.title: Ott's Masterwork

95125-complete.name: Ott
95125-complete.text:
This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.

Aka'Magosh, friend.
95125-complete.title: Ott's Masterwork

95126-accept.name: Ott
95126-accept.text: Here's the blade. You said that a $c named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
95126-accept.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95126-complete.name: Trevan Rol
95126-complete.text:
<Trevan takes the blade and inspects it carefully.> 

This will do nicely, $N. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great.

The only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.
95126-complete.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95126-progress.name: Trevan Rol
95126-progress.text: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?
95126-progress.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95140-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-accept.text:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140-accept.title: Old Fire-Eye

95140-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Banon may now rest in peace.

If you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.

<Lumina Windsinger's eyes begin to glow a vibrant blue as she touches the bloodstained blade in your hand.>

It is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, $c.
95140-complete.title: Old Fire-Eye

95140-progress.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-progress.text: Is it done? Is the beast slain?
95140-progress.title: Old Fire-Eye

95204-accept.name: Unknown
95204-accept.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204-accept.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-complete.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-complete.text:
<Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>

Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.

Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, $c. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-progress.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-progress.text: What have you got there, $c? A tasty morsel?
95204-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95216-complete.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.

Get out of my sight!
95216-complete.title: The New Plague

95216-progress.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-progress.text:
Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.

I must see this strain for myself!
95216-progress.title: The New Plague

95314-complete.name: Carolai Anise
95314-complete.text:
You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...

...but enough of superstition and rumors, $N. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.
95314-complete.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95328-accept.name: Unknown
95328-accept.text: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328-accept.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95328-complete.name: Father Lankester
95328-complete.text:
What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.

I welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, $c. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.
95328-complete.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95328-progress.name: Father Lankester
95328-progress.text: Do you have something for me, $c?
95328-progress.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95883-accept.name: Unknown
95883-accept.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The $r around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883-accept.title: The Tortured Soul

95883-complete.name: Unknown
95883-complete.text:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>
95883-complete.title: The Tortured Soul

95884-accept.name: Unknown
95884-accept.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884-accept.title: The Offering Stone

95885-accept.name: Unknown
95885-accept.text:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885-accept.title: The Offering of Blood

95885-complete.name: Unknown
95885-complete.text:
<The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>
95885-complete.title: The Offering of Blood

95981-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-complete.text:
Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.
95981-complete.title: Watching the Roads

96204-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-accept.text:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.
96204-accept.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96204-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-complete.text:
Thank you again, $N. I've been aquatinting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.

I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root. 

You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
96204-complete.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96895-accept.name: Deathguard Terrence
96895-accept.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895-accept.title: The Argent Emissary

96895-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96895-complete.text: Stay low and try not to be seen, $c. These cultists are not to be trifled with.
96895-complete.title: The Argent Emissary

96897-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-accept.text: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897-accept.title: The Cult of the Damned

96897-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
96897-complete.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-accept.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
96898-accept.title: Remnants of War

96898-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-complete.text: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
96898-complete.title: Remnants of War

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight

97288-accept.name: Unknown
97288-accept.text:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288-accept.title: Unending Torment

97288-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97288-complete.text:
Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that.

I think I have a use for this.
97288-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97289-accept.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching of this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289-accept.title: Unending Torment

97289-complete.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-complete.text:
<The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.>

You...
97289-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-progress.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-progress.text: <The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.>
97289-progress.title: Unending Torment

97290-accept.name: Unfinished Abomination
97290-accept.text:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290-accept.title: Unending Torment

97290-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97290-complete.text: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.
97290-complete.title: Unending Torment

97291-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-accept.text:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291-accept.title: Unending Torment

97291-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-complete.text: These will do nicely. We will see how much bravado our honored guest retains after he is subjected to my masterpiece.
97291-complete.title: Unending Torment

97291-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-progress.text: It will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?
97291-progress.title: Unending Torment

97292-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-complete.text:
Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home.

I have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.
97292-complete.title: Unending Torment

97292-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-progress.text:
For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.

And it's funny...
97292-progress.title: Unending Torment

97558-complete.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-complete.text: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.
97558-complete.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97953-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97953-accept.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97953-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97961-complete.name: Bowen Brisboise
97961-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97961-complete.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97963-complete.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
97963-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97963-complete.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97968-complete.name: Syriel Nightrain
97968-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97968-complete.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

98094-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
98094-accept.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094-accept.title: Scout Support

98248-accept.name: Unknown
98248-accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98248-accept.title: Shipping Label

98248-complete.name: Dokimi
98248-complete.text:
You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find out during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248-complete.title: Shipping Label

98248-progress.name: Dokimi
98248-progress.text: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248-progress.title: Shipping Label

98298-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-accept.text:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
98298-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

98298-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-complete.text:
It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.

These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.

Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.
98298-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

98298-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
