98298-progress.text: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
98298-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

98299-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98299-accept.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine. Be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken such as ourselves, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal.
98299-accept.title: Stop the Spread

98299-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98299-complete.text:
It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city.

Can you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?
98299-complete.title: Stop the Spread

98512-accept.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-accept.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512-accept.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98512-complete.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-complete.text:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
98512-complete.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98545-progress.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545-progress.title: Leonid's Letter

99-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
99-progress.text: Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, $N?
99-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience

99142-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-complete.text:
Most glorious indeed!

<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>

Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!

A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.
99142-complete.title: Tomb Weed

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed

99144-accept.name: Bareth Dawnstone
99144-accept.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144-accept.title: Seeking Refuge

99152-complete.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-complete.text: Well done, $c. With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
99152-complete.title: As Above, So Below

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker

99156-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-accept.text:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol
